App.Name: FolderPilot
App.Tagline: Find, organize and clean up your files — fast.
Notify.Running.Title: FolderPilot is running
Notify.Running.Body: Press {0} anywhere to jump to a folder. FolderPilot waits here in the tray.
Notify.HotkeyFailed.Title: Shortcut unavailable
Notify.HotkeyFailed.Body: {0} is already used by another app. Choose a different shortcut in Settings.
Notify.AutoTidy.Title: Downloads tidied
Notify.AutoTidy.Body: {0} new downloads sorted into folders. Undo anytime from History.
Notify.Undone.Title: Undone
Launcher.Placeholder: Jump to a folder or file…   type > for actions
Launcher.InExplorer: Opens in this File Explorer window
Launcher.Indexing: Still indexing your files ({0:N0} so far). Frequent folders work already.
Launcher.NoResults: No matches. Try fewer letters, or add a word from a parent folder.
Launcher.Hints: ↑↓ choose · Enter open · Ctrl+Enter show in folder · Shift+Enter new window · Ctrl+C copy path · Esc close
Launcher.EmptyHint: Type a few letters of any name. Add a word from a parent folder to narrow it down, like “college notes”.
Action.SaveWorkspace: Save open File Explorer windows as a workspace
Home.Subtitle: Here's what FolderPilot noticed in your folders.
Home.QuickJump.Title: Jump anywhere in a few keystrokes
Home.QuickJump.Body: Press {0} from anywhere — the desktop, File Explorer, even an app's Open or Save dialog — then type a few letters of any folder or file.
Home.AllTidy: All tidy. Nothing needs your attention right now.
Home.FrequentEmpty: Folders you open in File Explorer will show up here for one-click access.
Suggestion.Organize.Title: {0} has {1:N0} loose files
Suggestion.Organize.Body: Sort {2} of files into folders by type. You'll see a preview first.
Suggestion.Installers.Title: {0:N0} old installers in Downloads
Suggestion.Installers.Body: Setup files older than {1} days are taking {2}. Installed apps don't need them.
Suggestion.Unused.Title: {0} in files you haven't opened for {1} days
Suggestion.Unused.Body: {2:N0} files across your personal folders. Review them and recycle what you don't need.
Organize.Title: Organize a folder
Organize.Subtitle: Sort loose files into tidy subfolders. You see exactly what moves before anything happens, and you can undo it later.
Organize.Mode.ByTypeAndMonth: Folders by type, then by month
Organize.Nothing: Nothing to organize here. Files changed in the last 10 minutes are left alone.
Organize.Skipped: {0:N0} files stay where they are (shortcuts, or files in use or still downloading).
Organize.Skipped.One: 1 file stays where it is (a shortcut, or a file in use or still downloading).
Organize.Column.Name: File
Organize.Search: Find a file type or name, like “stl”…
Organize.Types.Title: Where each file type goes
Organize.Types.Hint: Don't like a folder name? Type your own — for example, send .stl files to “3D Prints”. Leave it as it is to use the default.
Organize.Types.Invalid: A folder name can't be empty or contain \ / : * ? " < > |
Organize.Remember: Remember my folder names for next time
Organize.DoneWithFailures: {0:N0} files organized. {1:N0} were in use and stayed put.
Organize.Undone: Undone — everything is back where it was.
Journal.Recycled: Moved {0:N0} items to the Recycle Bin
Journal.Recycled.One: Moved 1 item to the Recycle Bin
Cleanup.Title: Clean up
Cleanup.Subtitle: Find files you no longer need and get space back. Everything goes to the Recycle Bin first, and you can undo it.
Cleanup.MyFolders: My folders — Downloads, Desktop, Documents, Pictures, Videos, Music
Cleanup.DuplicateSummary: {0:N0} sets of duplicates · {1} could be freed
Cleanup.DuplicateSummary.One: 1 set of duplicates · {1} could be freed
Cleanup.KeepOldest: Select all but the oldest copy
Cleanup.Column.Name: Name
Cleanup.Confirm.Title: Move to Recycle Bin?
Cleanup.Confirm.Body: {0:N0} items ({1}) will go to the Recycle Bin. You can bring them back from History or from the Recycle Bin.
Cleanup.Confirm.Body.One: 1 item ({1}) will go to the Recycle Bin. You can bring it back from History or from the Recycle Bin.
Cleanup.Done: {0:N0} items moved to the Recycle Bin. {1} will be freed when you empty it.
Cleanup.Done.One: 1 item moved to the Recycle Bin. {1} will be freed when you empty it.
Cleanup.DoneSkipped: {0:N0} items couldn't be moved (in use, or on a drive without a Recycle Bin).
Cleanup.AccessOn: “Last used” is the last time a file was opened, changed or copied to this PC.
Cleanup.AccessOff: Windows isn't recording when files are opened on this PC, so “last used” means last changed or copied here.
Workspaces.Title: Workspaces
Workspaces.Subtitle: Save the folders you have open in File Explorer, then reopen them all in one click. Great for switching between projects, classes or clients.
Workspaces.OpenCount: {0:N0} File Explorer folders open right now
Workspaces.NoneOpen: Open the folders you want in File Explorer first, then save them here.
History.Title: History
History.Subtitle: Everything FolderPilot has changed. You can undo any of it.
History.Empty: Nothing yet. When you organize or clean up, it shows up here.
History.UndoPartial: Restored {0:N0} items. {1:N0} couldn't be restored — they may have been moved, deleted or emptied from the Recycle Bin.
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Theme.Hint: Pick a look. “Follow Windows” uses Sand when Windows is light and Midnight when it's dark.
Settings.Hotkey.Hint: Click the box, then press the keys you want.
Settings.Hotkey.Failed: That shortcut is taken by another app. Try a different one.
Settings.Learn: Learn which folders I use from File Explorer
Settings.Startup: Start FolderPilot when I sign in to Windows
Settings.ContextMenu: Add FolderPilot to the right-click menu of folders
Settings.ContextMenu.Note: On Windows 11 it appears under “Show more options”.
Settings.Index.SkipDot: Skip folders starting with a dot (.git, .vscode…)
Settings.Index.Status: {0:N0} items · {1} of memory · built in {2:0.0} s
Settings.Organize.Hint: Your own folder names for file types. They're used when you organize, and by automatic tidying.
Settings.Organize.Empty: None yet. Rename a folder in an Organize preview and it's saved here.
Settings.AutoTidy: Keep Downloads tidy automatically (sorts finished downloads by type every 15 minutes)
Settings.LowMemory: Low-memory mode — give memory back to Windows while FolderPilot is idle
Settings.Privacy.Body: FolderPilot works entirely on this PC. It never uploads your files, file names or usage, and it has no tracking or ads.
